projectContext: Sprint 26 continues test infrastructure maturity after Sprint 25 completed helpers/fixtures READMEs, parametrized test expansion (297 new cases), flaky test marking, agent healer assertion helpers, benchmark CI workflow, bulk marker assignment script, downloader fixture consolidation, and integration test runner. This sprint focuses on: (1) applying bulk marker assignment to classify 9,253 unmarked tests, (2) implementing marker-based CI workflow for 60% faster feedback, (3) measuring and enforcing fixture/helper adoption, (4) establishing benchmark baselines, (5) auditing test isolation patterns, (6) improving coverage in critical modules (agents, matching, stages), and (7) documenting mock patterns for developer onboarding.

userStories.title: Implement marker-based CI workflow for fast feedback
userStories.notes: Implemented marker-based CI in .github/workflows/tests.yml: fast-tests job runs pytest -m fast on PR updates (45s target), full-tests runs complete suite on merge to main only, offline-tests provides -m 'not requires_network' fallback. Added job summaries with test metrics and duration. Documented in tests/README.md. Commit: 9b3241a
